_about: POSITIONS of the human body (motion.js, docs/motion.md): every joint's angles, in degrees, by the joint model's own names (assets/people/joints.json) -- `spine`, `neck`, or `<side> <joint>` with side right, left or both (`both knees`). A movement not named stays at rest; a joint out of its range is clamped and reported. `root` turns the whole body (pitch: + face up, lying on the back at 90; roll; yaw); `anchor` is what keeps its place on the ground (feet, right foot, left foot, hands, knees, pelvis); `support` names two things it rests on at once (feet, hands, forearms, knees, pelvis, back) and the body's tilt is found so both touch. `mirror` is another position's mirror image, `from` another position with some joints changed. `reach` says where the hands go instead of how the arms bend -- { "hands": "toes" } (both, the trunk bending straight forward), or "right hand" / "left hand"; places: toes, knees, floor -- and each body finds its own bend (reach.js); `lean` what else may move to get there (true: the trunk, the hips, the knees; "spine": the trunk's bend alone; false: the arms alone).

stand._about: relaxed, the arms hanging -- the rest of every joint

arms out._about: the arms straight out to the sides

hands on hips._about: the elbows out and back, the hands at the waist's sides (found by search: the palm on the waist, nothing through the trunk)

squat._about: deep: the thighs level, the knees over the toes, the trunk leaning to keep the weight over the feet, the arms forward to balance

lunge right._about: the right foot stepped forward, its knee over the ankle; the left knee down near the floor, the left foot on its toes where it stood (the anchor: the foot that stays)

knee up right._about: a high knee: the right thigh level, the arms swinging the other way as in a run

toe touch._about: bent forward, the hands down to the toes: where they go is said (`reach`), and each body finds its own bend -- the spine curled, the pelvis tipped over the thighs, the knees a little soft if it must (reach.js)

side bend right._about: bending over to the right, the left arm over the head

twist right._about: the shoulders turned to the right over still hips, the arms out

jack open._about: a jumping jack's star: the arms up out to the sides, the feet apart

plank._about: on the forearms and the toes, the body one straight line

push-up up._about: the arms straight, the hands under the shoulders, the body straight from the heels to the head

push-up down._about: the chest a hand's breadth off the floor, the elbows bent back along the body

hands down._about: crouched, the knees wide, the trunk leaning between them, the head up, the hands put down on the floor just ahead of the shoulders -- the way down to the floor (and up from it); the trunk leaning as a person does there, the arms alone finding the floor on each body (`lean`: false)

sit floor._about: sitting on the floor, the knees up, the hands on them

crunch down._about: on the back, the knees up, the feet flat, the hands at the temples

kneel._about: upright on both knees, on the toes

press down._about: a shoulder press, low: the upper arms out level, the forearms up

positions._statuary: THE STATUES' STANDS (statues.js, assets/people/statuary.json): the classical ones first -- CONTRAPPOSTO, the weight on one leg: its hip high and the pelvis tipped down toward the free leg (root roll), the shoulders tipped back the other way (the spine's lateral bend), the free knee soft, its foot a little back on the ball; the head turned toward the leg that carries

contrapposto._about: the weight on the right leg, the left knee soft and its foot drawn back, the arms hanging (the left elbow a little bent)

orator._about: ADLOCUTIO (the Augustus of Prima Porta): addressing the crowd, the right arm raised forward and out, the hand open; the left forearm forward, carrying (a staff, a fold of the cloak)

spear bearer._about: the DORYPHOROS: the right arm hanging, the left bent forward at the elbow, its hand holding a spear upright at the shoulder

hand on hip._about: the left hand on the hip, the elbow out and back; the right arm hanging

offering._about: the right forearm forward and the palm up, holding out an offering (a bowl, a wreath); the left arm hanging

aloft._about: the right arm raised high (a torch, a wreath, a sword held up), the left forearm across the waist, carrying

blessing._about: a saint's: the right hand raised before the chest, blessing; the left forearm forward at the waist, holding a book

prayer._about: the hands joined before the breast, the head bowed

mourning._about: grieving: the head bowed and turned aside, the hands clasped low before the body

victor._about: both arms raised up and out, the head up -- a victory, a wreath held up in both hands

striding._about: the TYRANNICIDE's stride: the left foot forward, the right drawn back, the right arm raised back over the head (a sword about to strike), the left out forward (a shield, a cloak over it)

kneeling._about: the KNEELING WARRIOR of a pediment's slope (Aegina's, Olympia's): down on the right knee, its shin along the ground and the foot stretched back, the left foot planted with its knee up before him; the body upright and turned a little, the right arm raised (a spear, a sword) and the left forward under a shield

positions._seated: SEATED (statues.js: the figure built sitting -- people.js pose `sit`: its thighs along the seat, its skirt over the knees -- so these name the legs as it sits, and the pelvis keeps its place)

colossus._about: an Egyptian king enthroned: knees together, thighs level, shins plumb, upper arms close at the sides, the forearms along the thighs, the head up

seated._about: the thighs along the seat, the shins down, the hands on the thighs

enthroned._about: the god on his throne (the Zeus of Olympia): the right arm up and forward holding a sceptre upright, the left forearm along the thigh, palm up (a Victory, an orb), the head up

seated reading._about: both forearms forward over the lap, an open book in the hands, the head bowed over it

pensive._about: seated, leaning forward, the chin on the right hand (its elbow down toward the knee); the left forearm across the lap

positions._reclining: RECLINING (statues.js: a pediment's corner, a banquet's couch): the body ON ITS SIDE (root roll: toward its left), the trunk raised off the floor by the spine's bend to the other side and propped on the under arm, the legs along the floor (the hips' abduction bringing them down to it) -- the head toward its left, where the body lies

reclining._about: on the left side, propped on the left forearm (the roll found that rests it and the hip on the floor together), the forearm forward along the floor; the legs along it, the right knee drawn up over the left shin; the right hand at rest forward

positions._lotus: SEATED CROSS-LEGGED (statues.js: a Buddha's, Borobudur's): on the floor, the thighs out to either side and turned out in the hips, the knees bent all the way so the shins cross before the body, the right over the left -- the trunk upright; the hands in a MUDRA: laid in the lap one in the other (meditation), the right down over its knee to the earth, raised palm out (no fear), down open on the knee (the gift), before the breast (the teaching)

lotus._about: seated cross-legged in meditation: the hands in the lap; limber (joints.json): the shins turned flat on the floor, crossed

lotus earth._about: cross-legged, calling the earth to witness: the right arm down over its knee, the fingers toward the ground; the left hand in the lap

lotus fearless._about: cross-legged, the right hand raised before the shoulder, palm out (no fear); the left in the lap

lotus boon._about: cross-legged, the right arm down, the hand open on the knee (the gift); the left in the lap

lotus teaching._about: cross-legged, both hands before the breast (turning the wheel of the teaching)
